title: Central clinical database of the Collaborative Research Centre's INF/ S02 project (CRC/TRR295) "ReTune" to integrate the clinical core dataset
summary:
The ReTune project is a supraregional research project that investigates the effects of deep brain stimulation on various diseases. Deep brain stimulation involves surgically implanting a stimulation device into the brain. These diseases include, in particular, brain disorders that can severely impair patients' motor skills (e.g. Parkinson's disease).
Several projects within this consortium involve clinical studies to transfer the results from basic research and animal experiments to humans.
The aim of this subproject is to establish an information platform in which high-quality, uniform study data is collected and the data from research projects in different regions is compiled in a central clinical core database (dotbase). To this end, instructions for data collection are being drawn up, which all researchers must adhere to. This ensures that data collection, data storage and data transfer are carried out in the same way and to a high standard at all locations. This enables the reliable collection and evaluation of the effects of deep brain stimulation on patients with different diseases. The existing core clinical data set will be expanded for patients with Parkinson's disease to include additional modules – including stimulation parameters, biosamples, imaging parameters, electrophysiological parameters, disease progression milestones, and patient-reported outcomes using Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA). The cohort platform will be hosted on Charité's new dotbase platform and made available to all locations.
conditions: Patients with movement disorders Parkinson's disease,tremor, dystonia (G20-G26)

interventions.name: As part of usual care: Implantation of deep brain stimulation device
As part of usual care: No treatment with deep brain stimulation, because patients refuse this treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients are eligible for inclusion who: #1 Have been included in a corresponding study of a subproject of TR 295 and have consented to data transfer to the central clinical database as part of inclusion in the respective study.
OR #2 Patients with movement disorders Parkinson's disease, tremor, dystonia (G20-G26: Extrapyramidal diseases and movement disorders) who are receiving DBS treatment as part of their therapy and who have consented to inclusion in the central clinical database. OR #3 Patient:s with movement disorders Parkinson's disease, tremor, dystonia (G20-G26: Extrapyramidal diseases and movement disorders) who are eligible for DBS treatment as part of their therapy but have not opted for DBS treatment and have consented to inclusion in the central clinical database (control group).
Exclusion criteria:
No signed informed consent form / inclusion criteria are not met
